_README: Ground truth for the labeled reference images supplied with the project.
The label for each image comes from its filename, which is how the images
were supplied ('each is labeled with its correct location'). These labels
are the source of truth and must not be edited to match model output. If
the pipeline disagrees with a label, the pipeline is wrong.
expectedGroupSize is null where the supplied label says nothing about how
many people are present. Tests assert only that the result is a valid,
non-sensitive GroupSize in those cases rather than inventing a count.
analyzerFixture names a hand-authored file under analyzer_output/ holding
a deterministic representation of what the analyzers would emit for that
image. Those representations have NOT been produced by running ML Kit -
no such run has happened - so they are a reconstruction used to test the
fusion logic deterministically. Real model output is verified separately
on a physical device; see docs/PHYSICAL_SCAN_TESTS.md.
